race.comment: Siding with KINGSBURY (2) who ran a good race first up at Geelong when boxing on gamely for a narrow second. He'd promised good ability last time in having run very fast time on debut and with natural improvement and a bit of luck from the gate he can take this out. FARAKTA (8) ran a good race first up at Bendigo despite going under as a $2.40 chance. She just gave them too big a start there and can improve second up. KOOLATAH QUEEN (10) worked home fairly in a messy race first up at Wodonga and can improve off that, she gets in light after the claim and should take holding out.  RUSSIAN FRONT (6) is consistent and should be thereabouts again.
